blocks.html: If you haven't yet completed The Giant Dwarf quest, you will need to talk to or use "Cross-river" option on the Dwarven Ferryman to cross the river in Keldagrim.
Talk to Dondakan the Dwarf about cannonballs in the Keldagrim south-west mine.
blocks.text: Talk to Dondakan the Dwarf about cannonballs in the Keldagrim south-west mine.

options.text: Why are you firing a cannon at a wall?
So why were you trying to get through the rock again?

blocks.html: In the western half of the Keldagrim Palace (the big building in the centre of Keldagrim) ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), talk to the Dwarven Engineer who is located in the room with an anvil.
blocks.text: In the western half of the Keldagrim Palace (the big building in the centre of Keldagrim) ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US), talk to the Dwarven Engineer who is located in the room with an anvil.

recommended.html: A weapon of any kind to kill low-level scorpions and mining gear
recommended.text: A weapon of any kind to kill low-level scorpions and mining gear

blocks.html: Teleport to the Falador lodestone and run north-east to the Dwarven mines (stay outside)
blocks.text: Teleport to the Falador lodestone and run north-east to the Dwarven mines (stay outside)

substeps.html: Teleport using the skull sceptre and run west.
substeps.text: Teleport using the skull sceptre and run west.

substeps.html: Or teleport to the Invention Guild and run directly east.
substeps.text: Or teleport to the Invention Guild and run directly east.

blocks.html: Talk to Rolad, who is located in the most north-eastern building near the ladder to the mines. There is a pause in the dialogue; be sure to finish the whole conversation.
blocks.text: Talk to Rolad, who is located in the most north-eastern building near the ladder to the mines. There is a pause in the dialogue; be sure to finish the whole conversation.

blocks.html: Go down the ladder to enter the Dwarven mines.
blocks.text: Go down the ladder to enter the Dwarven mines.

blocks.html: Kill scorpions in the southeast part of the mine (by the mysterious entrance) to get the first page. It will appear in your backpack.
blocks.text: Kill scorpions in the southeast part of the mine (by the mysterious entrance) to get the first page. It will appear in your backpack.

blocks.html: Search the mine carts just to the north for the second page. They may also be in the mine carts just south of the ladder you entered the dungeon from.
blocks.text: Search the mine carts just to the north for the second page. They may also be in the mine carts just south of the ladder you entered the dungeon from.

blocks.html: Mine any ore rocks in the mine to find the last page (the rocks in the resource dungeon connected to the mine do not work).
blocks.text: Mine any ore rocks in the mine to find the last page (the rocks in the resource dungeon connected to the mine do not work).

blocks.html: Return to Rolad and read the book. Don't destroy the book yet.
blocks.text: Return to Rolad and read the book. Don't destroy the book yet.

substeps.html: If you don't have an ammo mould for the next step, it can be bought from Nulodion for 5 coins. The ammo mould can be stored on your tool belt.
substeps.text: If you don't have an ammo mould for the next step, it can be bought from Nulodion for 5 coins. The ammo mould can be stored on your tool belt.

needed.html: Gold bar and ammo mould (tool belt works)
needed.text: Gold bar and ammo mould (tool belt works)

blocks.html: Return to Dondakan in the Keldagrim south-west mine. Talk to him, and then use a gold bar on him.
blocks.text: Return to Dondakan in the Keldagrim south-west mine. Talk to him, and then use a gold bar on him.

blocks.html: Head to any furnace with an ammo mould and make a golden cannonball.
blocks.text: Head to any furnace with an ammo mould and make a golden cannonball.

substeps.html: There is a furnace in the west of the Keldagrim Palace, in the north-eastern corner.
substeps.text: There is a furnace in the west of the Keldagrim Palace, in the north-eastern corner.

blocks.html: Return to Dondakan and use the golden cannonball on him.
blocks.text: Return to Dondakan and use the golden cannonball on him.

options.text: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.
So you want to... fire me into the rock?
I can't argue with that, shoot me in!

needed.html: 3 gold bars (must be in the backpack, metal bank does not work)
needed.text: 3 gold bars (must be in the backpack, metal bank does not work)

blocks.html: Read the dwarven lore book to find a piece of base schematics.
blocks.text: Read the dwarven lore book to find a piece of base schematics.

substeps.html: If you lost the book, you may speak to Rolad.
substeps.text: If you lost the book, you may speak to Rolad.

blocks.html: Teleport to the Taverley lodestone, run north and enter the cave by the tree patch.
blocks.text: Teleport to the Taverley lodestone, run north and enter the cave by the tree patch.

blocks.html: Go to the bar inside the Dwarven Tunnel and talk to Khorvak, a dwarven engineer.
blocks.text: Go to the bar inside the Dwarven Tunnel and talk to Khorvak, a dwarven engineer.

options.text: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!

blocks.html: Talk to the Dwarven Engineer on the west side of the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Keldagrim Palace (the same one you went to earlier) for another part of the schematics.
blocks.text: Talk to the Dwarven Engineer on the west side of the ground floor (UK) / 1st floor (US) of the Keldagrim Palace (the same one you went to earlier) for another part of the schematics.

blocks.html: Assemble on any of the schematics.
blocks.text: Assemble on any of the schematics.

blocks.html: Move around (and rotate if needed) the pieces, referring to finished schematics pictured right.
blocks.text: Move around (and rotate if needed) the pieces, referring to finished schematics pictured right.

blocks.html: Smith a gold helmet on the anvil in the same room which requires three gold bars by using a gold bar on the anvil.
blocks.text: Smith a gold helmet on the anvil in the same room which requires three gold bars by using a gold bar on the anvil.

substeps.html: If you are proceeding or completed Legends' Quest.
substeps.text: If you are proceeding or completed Legends' Quest.

blocks.html: Prepare to fight a level 50-56 enemy, along with your gold helmet.
blocks.text: Prepare to fight a level 50-56 enemy, along with your gold helmet.

blocks.html: Return to Dondakan, equip your gold helmet and ask him to shoot you into the rock.
blocks.text: Return to Dondakan, equip your gold helmet and ask him to shoot you into the rock.

substeps.html: During the cutscene, click directly on the text "Click to continue", clicking anywhere else will exit and restart the cutscene.
substeps.text: During the cutscene, click directly on the text "Click to continue", clicking anywhere else will exit and restart the cutscene.

blocks.html: Once inside the cave, do not remove the gold helmet or you will have to restart.
blocks.text: Once inside the cave, do not remove the gold helmet or you will have to restart.

blocks.html: Mine at least 6 gold ores, which is required to damage the enemy, and keep them in the backpack. The more ores mined (up to a maximum of 15), the lower its combat level.
blocks.text: Mine at least 6 gold ores, which is required to damage the enemy, and keep them in the backpack. The more ores mined (up to a maximum of 15), the lower its combat level.

blocks.html: Jump-through the first wall of flames and right-click talk on the next ring of fire.
blocks.text: Jump-through the first wall of flames and right-click talk on the next ring of fire.

blocks.html: Kill the Arzinian Avatar.
blocks.text: Kill the Arzinian Avatar.

blocks.html: Speak to Dondakan.
blocks.text: Speak to Dondakan.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

items.html: 5,000 experience lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)
items.text: 5,000 experience lamp (Skill must be level 30 or higher)

items.html: Players may keep their gold helmet and access the Arzinian Mine, where 146 gold rocks and veins can be found.
items.text: Players may keep their gold helmet and access the Arzinian Mine, where 146 gold rocks and veins can be found.
subs: A dwarven boatman due east of the mine will bank the player's gold ore for a small fee; He keeps 20% of the ores, rounded up, or 10% if the player has the ring of charos (a).
